title: Incorrect information about what is being sent to Bing Maps
body:
Hello, I have had it verified by Microsoft engineers that under 'What is sent to Bing Maps', statements pertaining to sending filter bucket information to Bing Maps is incorrect (first para and first bullet point). Only the Location, Latitude and Longitude are being sent to Bing Maps. The filter data stays within the PBI data service. Please correct this as this has led to a lot of confusion and indicates a breach of privacy. Thank you.
